facts: Narine Villas is an off-plan development of detached villas in Ayia Triada, a coastal residential area north of Protaras and Paralimni in the Famagusta district.
The villas currently offered (H07, plan type Bm, and H08, plan type B) have three bedrooms and four bathrooms, 154.85 m² of internal area, a 28.8 m² covered veranda and a 20 m² roof garden.
The two villas on the price list stand on plots of 343 m² and 320 m²; each has uncovered parking and its own skimmer pool.
The specification describes a ground floor and a first floor, with ceramic floor tiles throughout, including the internal staircase.

Walls are 25 cm thermal bricks with a certified external thermal insulation system; aluminium frames are thermally broken with double glazing, and balcony balustrades are 16 mm laminated safety glass.
Each villa receives an energy performance certificate; the specification states energy class A.
A 3 kWp photovoltaic system is installed on the roof, alongside a solar water heater with a 1,000-litre tank, a 200-litre cylinder and a 2.4 m² collector; the supply is three-phase.
The pool is reinforced concrete, skimmer type, mosaic-lined, 1.40 m deep, with two LED lights, grey ceramic coping and an outdoor shower.
Electrical provisions include CAT6 and RG6 TV/data points, USB-C sockets by the beds, a videophone, an EV charging point at the parking space, and provisions for CCTV and an alarm.
Kitchen and wardrobe units are melamine (allowance up to €190/m) with soft-close hinges and large-format porcelain worktops (allowance up to €160/m).

conflicts: NO image of the Narine villas themselves exists in the share: there is no renders folder. The only non-drone image (5. AERIAL LAYOUTS/IMG-20260527-WA0034.jpg, 1600x881) is a dusk aerial view of the neighbourhood with modern villas and pools along the road; it is NOT clear whether these are Narine renders composited into the photo or existing neighbouring houses. It is used as the gallery hero only for lack of anything better; the operator should check it or replace it with a real render.

All other gallery images are honest plot/setting photos: DJI_0253-0262 ('PLOT PHOTOS') are high-altitude drone shots of the Ayia Triada coastline, fishing shelter and beach around the plot; DJI_0263-0282 ('1ST/2ND/3RD FLOOR') are drone shots taken above the plot at floor heights to show the future views (field in the foreground, sea and neighbouring houses beyond). None of them shows a villa of this project.

Developer's website (karmadevelopers.com, not downloaded): no Narine project page. The media library holds four Narine images uploaded Sep-Nov 2026: /wp-content/uploads/2026/11/narine.jpg (560x400), /2026/10/karma-5-vat-narine.jpg (1400x640, a branded campaign banner), /2026/09/narine.jpg (324x328), /2026/09/narine-v2.jpg (700x525). The spec file is named 'NARINE D' while the price-list villas are plan types B and Bm; it is not stated whether the spec applies equally to all plan types.
The spec is in Greek only and states 'all prices in the description include VAT' (material allowances), while the price list is ex-VAT; this only concerns the allowance figures, not the sale prices.
